theme.name: Time Without Consequence
theme.description: A tarot deck derived from Alexi Murdoch's album 'Time Without Consequence', exploring the journey from isolation and searching through witness and presence to recognition and home. The album's central conceit—the second-person 'you' who is simultaneously beloved, lost self, inner voice, and divine presence—structures the suits as four relationships to this absent/present other. The deck works on multiple levels: as navigation of romantic longing, as map of internal fragmentation and integration, and as spiritual practice of staying present through time's passage.

seeking.name: Seeking
seeking.description: The you I'm searching for, the quest itself, the long road walked. This suit encompasses active longing, the discipline of continued seeking, following clues and signs, the gap between here and there. It holds both the necessity of the search and its potential to become endless deferral of arrival.

seeing.description: The you who's suffering and hiding, the you I'm trying to reach, the you who sees me. major_arcana.story: A journey from restless searching through isolation and confusion, into the practice of staying present and witnessing both self and other, through dissolution and the terror of abandonment, arriving finally at recognition, home, and the simple grace of breathing. The Fool walks all their days on many roads, falls and learns they can bleed, discovers the discipline of breath, sees and is seen, drifts into blue mind, asks 'will you wait for me,' overcomes fear of light, and ultimately finds that salvation lies in love—not as distant destination but as the ground they were always standing on. The narrative honors both readings: romantic longing for absent beloved and contemplative integration of fragmented self.

It may indicate burdened by 'all of my days' as weight, unable to begin because you've already been walking, or the shadow manifestation of lost in past roads, cannot see the present path, time as prison rather than medium, exhaustion masquerading as wisdom.
